pack.name: The Proving Ground
pack.description: The smallest thing this engine will accept that is still a whole adventure: one room, one recruit, one straw golem, one chalk mark on the wall, and a strongbox you win by opening. It exists to prove a pack is portable — nothing in js/ names it, and the suite is free to break it in ways it would never break the vault.

commands.name: Strike
commands.flavour: A drill-yard swing, and the only one you were taught.

commands.name: Field Poultice
commands.flavour: Cloth, tallow and a great deal of optimism.

pcOptions.name: The Recruit
pcOptions.title: Absalom Levy 1
pcOptions.blurb: One sword, one poultice, no spells. There is nothing here to choose between; the picker still runs, which is the point.
pcOptions.paletteNote: Brass, so nothing in this pack reads as the vault's blue wizard or green fighter at a glance.

straw-golem.name: Straw Golem
straw-golem.note: A training dummy that hits back, deliberately weaker than anything in the vault: this pack is a fixture, and a fixture that is hard to win is a fixture whose failures are ambiguous.

startingInventoryNote: The item id is "potion" because game.js's potionCount() knows that one id by name — the only content id the engine hardcodes. A pack that calls its healing item anything else still works and still heals; the autopilot's drink-when-low branch is the one thing that goes quiet. See the guide's §11.

chalk-mark.title: The Chalk Mark
body: Chalked on the post, in a drill sergeant's hand: "Hit it until it stops. If it stops you first, that was also the lesson."
Below that, a tally of scratches somebody gave up counting.
chalk-mark.logLine: You read the chalk mark on the post. It is not encouraging.

yard.name: The Proving Yard
yard.hint: Read the post, put the golem down, and open the strongbox.

treasure.blockedHint: The golem is still on its feet.
treasure.title: The Strongbox
body: Inside: a levy's pay chit, a spare bootlace, and the sergeant's signature.

defeat.title: Down in the Yard
body: The straw golem stands over you, unbothered. They will chalk another scratch on the post.

intro.narrative: A drill yard under the Ascendant Court, swept, chalked, and entirely without ceremony.
intro.goal: Read the post, put the golem down, and open the strongbox.
intro.hint: Click a lit tile to walk, or use the arrow keys.
